create_pybullet_simulation: connect to pybullet GUI and load a URDF plane and cube into the simulation
create_constraint: create a fixed joint constraint on a loaded URDF body using p.createConstraint
change_constraint_dynamically: update a constraint pivot position and orientation each frame using p.changeConstraint
remove_constraint: remove an existing constraint from the pybullet simulation using p.removeConstraint
get_constraint_unique_id: retrieve a constraint unique id by index using p.getConstraintUniqueId
